question: Which shipping route should the order take?
context: The order must arrive within 10 days. The budget is $12,000.

evidence.text: Sea freight takes 21 days and costs $3,000.
Air freight takes 3 days and costs $11,000. Customs adds one day unless pre-clearance forms are filed two days before dispatch.

fields.name: preclear
fields.description: are the customs forms filed before dispatch
